package.name: sweetie_bot_vision_proxy
package.description: C++ front transport + visualizer for the Sweetie Bot vision federation: gstreamer ingest, cyclic frame ring buffer, Boost.Beast WebSocket to the provider container, flat-JSON round-trip to the py3.10 tracker-fuser, and overlay/publish to ROS (/image_raw, /detections, /hmi/vision_skeletons, /vision_proxy/result_json). Restores the original vision_proxy prototype's design; replaces the python gasket as the single ROS face.
